articles.headline: Todd Monken, QBs, the Browns and a lifetime in pursuit
articles.description: At age 60, the first-time head coach brings to Cleveland a gritty resolve, an ability to cut through to QBs and a dream that this will be "my last job."

images.caption: Todd Monken inherited a Browns team that went 5-12 last season and a franchise that hasn't been to the postseason since a wild-card loss on Jan. 13, 2024.

images.name: Jeff Monken [576x324]
images.caption: Football is in the Monken blood, as Todd's cousin Jeff is the head football coach at Army.
